note: Two stop lists with different days, a name label and a visit date at the top. No surgery date is printed, so the patient enters it
pageText:
Patient: Jane Rivera    MRN: 4471982
Visit date: 10/12/2026
Pre-Surgery Instructions

7 days before surgery, STOP taking:
• Aspirin 325 mg
• Fish oil and all vitamins

4 days before surgery, STOP taking:
• Ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin)
• Naproxen (Aleve)

You may take Tylenol (acetaminophen) for pain.
Bring your inhalers to the hospital.
answer: Aspirin: action stop, strength "325 mg", whenText "7 days before surgery", startDay -7
Fish oil and all vitamins: isGroup true, action stop, whenText "7 days before surgery", startDay -7
Ibuprofen: otherNames ["advil", "motrin"], action stop, whenText "4 days before surgery", startDay -4
Naproxen: otherNames ["aleve"], action stop, whenText "4 days before surgery", startDay -4
Task "Bring your inhalers to the hospital": dueDay 0
surgeryDate empty: only the visit date 10/12/2026 is printed. The patient enters the surgery date and every day counts from it
